changelog:
- Search Engine Suite Overhaul: Replaced Brave Search and Startpage with official Yahoo Search across Android and Desktop. Added authentic vector brand logos for Yahoo, DuckDuckGo, and Ecosia.
- Reels & Shorts Pull-to-Refresh Glitch Prevention: Automatically pauses pull-to-refresh on vertical video feeds (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook Reels, Stories) so dragging down smoothly returns to previous videos without triggering unintended page reloads.
- Premium Light Theme & System Sync: Added System Theme Sync to auto-adapt light or dark appearance based on device settings, alongside manual Daylight Mode controls. Enhanced bottom menu with dynamic daylight/night theme switcher and sun/moon icons.
- Light Theme Sailboat Wallpapers: Introduced high-definition sunlit sailboat and coastal yacht wallpapers designed specifically to complement the light pearl interface while keeping dark themes intact.
